description: Use when the user wants a cinematic tour made from three to six room images in order. The workspace offers an automatic or user-written script and 12-, 15-, or 30-second durations.

additional_instructions.description: Optional user preferences stated in natural language. Do not ask for this when the request is already clear.

duration_seconds.description: The workspace offers 12, 15, or 30 seconds. Omit unless the user requests one; the default is 12 seconds.

anyOf.description: A complete data:image/jpeg, data:image/png, or data:image/webp base64 URI supplied by the client.

data.description: The existing base64 image bytes. Pass them unchanged; do not regenerate or summarize them.

items.description: A public HTTPS image URL or the existing inline base64 image supplied by the client. Never pass file:// URLs, local paths, invented bytes, or file metadata.

images.description: Three to six room images attached by the user in tour order.

items.description: An attached image supplied by a file-aware client. If the host only exposes a local path, omit this field so RoomLab can request the image safely.

download_url.description: A temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by the host. Never construct this from a local path.

tour_script.description: Optional user-written tour script. Omit to use RoomLab’s professional automatic tour.
